title: Bounded-error decision with a success threshold
statement: A finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ decides a language $L$ within time bound $T$ with success threshold $p$ if, for every Boolean input $x$, every computation halts within $T(|x|)$ steps and the probability that its output equals the indicator of membership of $x$ in $L$ is at least $p(|x|)$.
hypotheses_covered: Output probability of the correct membership bit is at least $p(|x|)
